item.title: My Favorite Mobile Game | Matteuss
item.description:
How I Started

I started played Clash royale around 8 years ago. It was just normal game back then when no one played it. I just wanted to do same thing what my friends did. Around 2 years ago I created new account so i can re-start it from 0. Since then Clash been on it's peak and I am playing whenever i am bored and trying to kill time.
